expected_value_creation: A reviewer can reconstruct each evaluator lane, its evidence and dependencies, preserved dissent, revision lineage, governed retirement, and the bounded basis of a joined judgment.
beneficiary: QIF users, affected stakeholders, independent reviewers, governance owners, and hybrid human-AI organizations
supporting_evidence: Anthropic reports correlated multi-agent failures, hidden-profile coordination gaps, and weak epistemic vigilance.
OpenAI distinguishes persistent reusable memory from current-session history and keeps human-reviewed artifacts as the source of truth.
success_criteria: Every joined judgment retains all input memories, dissent, shared dependencies, authority boundaries, and evidence.
Revision and retirement never erase historical judgment records, and unresolved conflicts or weak independence route governance.
